references.observations: ColdShine,2007 ordinary lower-lungotevere picture: three shallow open masonry arches, two rounded river piers with bases and springing caps, pale arch-ring voussoirs, horizontally coursed stone spandrels, cornice and circular pierced parapet. Lubin23,2012 ordinary streetlight picture: green-patinated metal shaft, large collar, frosted globe and scrolling rostral projections. Relief sculpture is reduced to medium-fi silhouette forms. No photo pixels copied.
